description:
Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) and Alternative Provision (AP) Adviser 

As a general requirement the Supplier will:

provide valuable expertise to advise, challenge and support at risk or poor performing local areas/local area partnerships in continuing to develop and implement robust and achievable plans to improve its SEND and AP services. 

provide advice and support to ensure the pace of improvement is appropriate and that improvements to the SEND and AP system are sustainable; 

ensure plans remain focused on outcomes for children and young people with SEND and inform the quality of the service in readiness for the next Ofsted inspection.

engage at both strategic and operational level 

contribute to the department's formal reviews of the local area/local area partnership's progress and make a recommendation to VCU on whether progress has been sufficient;  

provide regular written reports to the department on the local area/local area partnership's progress to VCU, and more frequently if the pace of progress is not sufficient.  

have an awareness of the proposed SEND/AP system and Children's Social Care reforms including the Change Programme and work closely with relevant colleagues in supporting and challenging local areas/local area partnerships. 

develop working relationships with Health partners where this helps achieve the objectives set out in the contract.

description:

description: Barnsley Council is seeking Providers who will supply  three x 10 Day Training courses focusing on preparing participants to secure work in the Hospitality and Visitor Economy sector. The training programme must be suitable for unemployed and economically inactive residents of the Barnsley area. It should equip candidates with a knowledge and understanding of the attributes and skills already identified and expected by sector employers. Preparing them with the minimum standards essential in suitable job applicants so they are able to undertake a short work placement with a prospective employer.

title: Smoking Cessation Website, Social Media & PR Campaign - Yorkshire and Humber
description:
NHS Humber and North Yorkshire ICB has agreed to work with local authority colleagues across, East Yorkshire, North Yorkshire, Northern Lincolnshire, West Yorkshire and South Yorkshire to pool financial resources to support the delivery of a smoking cessation mass media campaign across the Yorkshire and Humber region. This will mean the smoking cessation mass media campaign will cover the following local authority areas: Wakefield, Leeds, Kirklees, Calderdale, Bradford, Doncaster, Sheffield, Barnsley, Rotherham in addition to Kingston upon Hull, East Riding of Yorkshire, North East Lincolnshire, North Lincolnshire, City of York and North Yorkshire. 

As part of the smoking cessation mass media campaign, it has been identified that associated communication assets - website, social media and public relations are required to further support and signpost the Yorkshire and Humber population to information, advice and guidance on how to stop / quit smoking.

The requirements include but not limited to:
•	Website - creation, production and launch of a smoking cessation website.
•	Search engine optimisation (SEO) - to amplify and raise the profile of the website.
•	Social Media Strategy - development of a social media strategy with ongoing support, including social media toolkit.
•	Digital and social media paid for advertising - during the smoking cessation mass media campaign.
•	Public Relations (PR) support - Pin the lead up to, and during the mass media smoking cessation campaign period.

NHS Humber and North Yorkshire ICB has agreed to work with local authority colleagues across, East Yorkshire, North Yorkshire, Northern Lincolnshire, West Yorkshire and South Yorkshire to pool financial resources to support the delivery of a smoking cessation mass media campaign across the Yorkshire and Humber region.
